sentences.en: Consisting of bacon and cheese, the sandwich was quite greasy.
sentences.zh: 这个三明治由培根和奶酪制成，吃起来很油腻。

sentences.en: The food at that restaurant is too greasy for me.
sentences.zh: 那家餐馆的食物对我来说太油腻了。

sentences.en: I feel greasy and sweaty after going to the gym.
sentences.zh: 去健身房后我感觉浑身油腻出汗。
